title: Перенумерация четырёхуровневого плана по отступам
notes: Expected numbering is computed by the generator and asserted equal to a hand-written list of 23 numbers. Traps: stale old numbers with gaps, a duplicate and a wrong parent (4.2.1. under 4.1.); titles that start with digits ('3D-печать', '1С: интеграция' with Cyrillic С, '2027 год', '12 месяцев'); four levels. Broken variants: counters not reset per parent, number swallowed from the title by a greedy [\d. ]+ pattern, no trailing dot.
